text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"\"learn a lesson, new things and methods to solve it\"","quality":"sentence control","description":"This captures the ability to build clear, mostly controlled sentences with fewer disruptive grammar and agreement problems."},{"evidence":"\"when a problem is present\" repeated in a logical progression","quality":"organizational coherence","description":"This captures how ideas are sequenced and connected in a more orderly, easy-to-follow way."},{"evidence":"\"For example you are facing a bigger problem...\" and \"For another example, imagine yourself as a detective\"","quality":"development with examples","description":"This captures using relevant examples to expand and support the main point in a more sustained way."},{"evidence":"\"what is it that is making the problem, what it is affecting, and whom is it affecting\"","quality":"idea elaboration","description":"This captures more detailed explanation of a claim rather than brief or repetitive assertion."},{"evidence":"\"because the bigger you get, the bigger your problems become\"","quality":"natural expression","description":"This captures more fluent, idiomatic phrasing that sounds more like standard English usage."}]}
